reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "SwarmMode: In v3, the provider Docker has been split into 2 providers: - Docker provider (without Swarm support) - Swarm provider (Swarm support only) ???", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: upgrade-blocked

consequence.statement: A configuration using the Docker provider with swarmMode is unsupported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting.
consequence.remediation: Do not use swarmMode with the Docker provider; use the Swarm provider instead.

proposed.statement: In v3 the Docker provider's swarmMode option is unsupported (Swarm moved to a separate Swarm provider), and configuring providers.docker.swarmMode prevents Traefik from starting.
